name: smells_like_a_bulldogs_win
description:
Feeling down in the dumps?  Is your team's performance leaving you feeling deflated like a poorly thrown Hail Mary?  Then you need the "Smells Like a Bulldogs Win" candle – your new game day lucky charm.

Forget pre-game jitters and post-game blues. This isn't just a candle; it's a motivational speaker, a personal cheerleader, and a surprisingly good-smelling friend all rolled into one.  Crafted from 100% natural soy wax and infused with a scent that's as triumphant as a last-minute touchdown, this candle will fill your space with the aroma of victory - even if your team’s actual performance is… less than stellar.

A great addition to any Georgia fan's collection. Because let's be honest, sometimes the only thing better than a real Dawgs win is the smell of one. Gooooo Dawgs! Sic-em! Woof! Woof! Woof! Woof! Woof!
